description.value: Founded in 1979 and named after the rival bar in Casablanca, The Blue Parrot Coffee is a family-owned café tucked inside the Granville Island Public Market, offering what many consider the best espresso in Metro Vancouver using Italian La Cimbali machines. The Granville Island location boasts a spectacular vantage point with views of the mountains, ocean, and downtown Vancouver — a natural rest stop on one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors. The business operates as a certified 'Beyond Green™' enterprise, prioritizing eco-friendly practices and organic coffees.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Granville Island Public Market location at 1689 Johnston Street, matching the OSM address and phone number (604-688-5127). The site describes an active café founded in 1979, currently running a Jamaican Blue Mountain promotion, confirming it is open. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: The OSM record covers only the Granville Island Public Market location; a second location exists at Hillcrest Community Centre (4575 Clancy Loranger Way, 604-879-3301) and should not be merged with this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, well-reviewed café at Granville Island Public Market — a high-traffic cycling destination on the Vancouver waterfront. Strong cycling-corridor relevance warrants inclusion even though cycling-specific amenities were not confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website postal code (V6H 3R9) added to address; not present in OSM tags.
